description: Strips React/Next.js hydration scripts, Shopify Liquid/WordPress DOM bloat, and inline SVGs/CSS from any URL, returning clean Byte-0 GitHub-Flavored Markdown (GFM) with front-loaded Schema.org tables. Use this tool when you need to read a web page or pricing table inside an LLM context window without exceeding the 25,000-token truncation limit. Do not use this tool if you only need a diagnostic readiness score or robots.txt check (use audit_ai_readiness instead). Read-only HTTP extraction; requires no API key.

url.description: Fully qualified URL of the web page to convert into Byte-0 Markdown (e.g., "https://vercel.com/pricing").

name: extract_byte0_markdown
title: Extract Clean Byte-0 Markdown & Schema Tables from URL
